/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess

def browser(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"browser.py\", *map(str, args)], text=True))

def inspect(selector):
    return browser(\"inspect\", selector)[\"result\"]

style_keys = (\"bg\", \"color\", \"border\", \"weight\", \"radius\")
for width, height in ((1024, 768), (320, 640)):
    browser(\"open\", width, height)
    primary_style = inspect(\"#office\")[\"visual\"]
    submit = inspect(\"#send\")
    clear = inspect(\"#clear\")
    assert all(submit[\"visual\"][key] == primary_style[key] for key in style_keys)
    assert clear[\"visual\"][\"bg\"] == \"rgb(255, 255, 255)\"
    for button in (clear, submit):
        x, _, button_width, button_height = button[\"bounds\"]
        assert x >= 0 and x + button_width <= width and button_height >= 40
    for selector in (\"#office\", \"#vessel\", \"#slot\", \"#clear\", \"#send\"):
        browser(\"press\", \"Tab\")
        assert inspect(selector)[\"focused\"], selector
    initial = inspect(\"#send\")
    assert initial[\"visible\"] and \"solid 3px\" in initial[\"visual\"][\"outline\"]
    browser(\"press\", \"Enter\")
    response = browser(\"view\")
    assert \"Enter a vessel name.\" in response[\"result\"][\"text\"]
    correction = inspect(\"#send\")
    assert correction[\"focused\"] and correction[\"visible\"]
    assert correction[\"visual\"] == initial[\"visual\"]
    assert inspect(\"#clear\")[\"visual\"] == clear[\"visual\"]
    browser(\"press\", \"Shift+Tab\")
    assert inspect(\"#clear\")[\"focused\"]
    browser(\"press\", \"Space\")
    assert \"Enter a vessel name.\" not in browser(\"view\")[\"result\"][\"text\"]
    print(f\"{width}×{height}: action styles, button fit, keyboard order, empty submission, focus ring, and clear passed\")

browser(\"fill\", \"#vessel\", \"  Test Vessel  \")
browser(\"select\", \"#slot\", \"Afternoon\")
browser(\"click\", \"#send\")
assert \"Arrival requested for Test Vessel · Afternoon.\" in browser(\"view\")[\"result\"][\"text\"]
browser(\"click\", \"#clear\")
assert inspect(\"#vessel\")[\"value\"] == \"\"
assert inspect(\"#slot\")[\"value\"] == \"Morning\"
assert \"Arrival requested for\" not in browser(\"view\")[\"result\"][\"text\"]
browser(\"click\", \"#office\")
assert \"Open Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00.\" in browser(\"view\")[\"result\"][\"text\"]
browser(\"open\", 1024, 768)
print(\"Booking confirmation, form reset, and counter hours passed\")
PY"
